summary_1line: Ravana angrily marches to battle with a vast army despite ominous portents foretelling his death and begins slaughtering monkeys on the battlefield.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana stands on his radiant chariot glittering like many suns as armies roar around him and war drums thunder across Lanka.
A vulture lands on Ravana’s banner while meteors fall, jackals howl, and the darkened sky rains blood as he rides out to war.
Ravana whirls his chariot in battle, golden arrows flying as monkeys fall wounded and scattered across the field.
